title: Slayers
summary: Maddox's slayer quests, Hypixel's four bosses, their drops and odds, slayer levels and the gear they unlock.

s.x: stands in the Hub. Pay him for a quest, earn Combat XP from the right mobs, and the boss rises next to you. Beat it for slayer XP, Combat XP and its drops. Slayer levels give stats and SkyBlock XP, and unlock the crafting recipes for slayer gear. Everything here (bosses, costs, health, drops, odds and levels) comes from Hypixel SkyBlock.
Talking to Maddox opens the quest screen. The
page in the menu shows each boss, your level, every tier and what each level unlocks.
Pick a boss and a tier at Maddox and pay the cost.
Kill that boss's mobs. Each kill adds its
to the quest bar: a zombie gives 6, a wolf 10, an enderman 12.
When the bar is full, the boss rises next to you, with a boss bar and a clock.
Kill it before the clock runs out: 3 minutes for tiers I and II, 4 minutes above.
If the clock runs out or you die, the quest fails and the coins are gone.

Bosses only rise where there are mobs to fight: in a Hub area with mobs, or out in the world, but never on your island. The boss follows you around that area. If you leave it, log off or change dimension, the boss goes away and comes back with the time that was left.

A cave spider rides it. Hits on the rider go to the Broodfather.
(I): every 7 seconds it leaps behind you. Its hits from behind deal +50% damage (+75%, +100%, +125%, +150% at II to V).
(II): while it lives, everyone fighting it heals 25% less (50%, 75%, 99% at III to V), and every fifth hit lowers your Speed a little more (0.5% of the 400 cap a stack, 1% at III and IV, 2% at V).

(III): at 66% and 33% health it leaps away, webs the ground around it and lays egg sacs above itself: 2 sacs of 3 hits at III, 3 of 6 at IV, 4 of 9 at V. Smash them within 12 seconds or each hatches two cave spiders.
(IV): from 66% health, magic can't hurt it and it releases 5 bats every 20 seconds. Each bat alive takes 1% of your health a second as True Damage (2% at V).

(I): when it spawns, and at two thirds and a third of its health, it raises a shield of 15 hits (30 at II, 60 at III, 100 at IV). Every hit takes one off, whatever it deals; until it breaks, nothing gets through. From II the shield also makes it hit 3,000 harder every 3 seconds it stays up.
(I): it teleports behind or beside you every 8 seconds, every 4 if you stand still. From II it also deals half its damage per second to everyone within 6.5 blocks, every second.

(II): from half its health (two thirds at III and IV), and never while its shield is up, it holds a beacon for 2 seconds and throws it nearby. Stand on or right next to it within 5 seconds to break it, or it kills everyone fighting (a thousand times their health as True Damage).
(III): from a third of its health, a floating head appears near you every 6 seconds (up to 5). Look straight at one for half a second to destroy it. Together they deal
damage a second (2,000 a head at IV), and if that outdoes the boss's own damage, the boss itself stops hitting.

(IV): at 5/6, 1/2 and 1/6 of its health it sits still for 8 seconds, can't be hurt, and sweeps four beams around it. A beam takes 25% of your health as True Damage and cuts your healing by 12% for 90 seconds.
